text:
Alex W: Morning handoff — I'm primary until 22:00 UTC. Quick status: no open Sev1s, but we have a partial degradation reported on embeddings-service (INC-2147) affecting ~10% of requests, mitigation in progress. Primary = Alex W, Secondary = Mira P. 

Mira P: Copy. I'll be reachable via pager and will cover if you need to drop out for a meeting. Any outstanding customer-impact comms? :eyes:

Alex W: Yes, Outreach team is seeing timeouts for longer sequences. Engineering is throttling a few models; I've pushed a temporary route to fallback-model-v1 to reduce errors. Notified SRE-runbook owners.

incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT UPDATE (INC-2147) — Severity: P2 -> trending P2. Affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants (partial), error rate spike started 1712347200 UTC. Pager rule triggered by 5xx > 3m.

Lena R: Thanks Alex. For handoff clarity: who's the escalation path if latency increases or customer impact widens? I want us to avoid surprises during the evening window.

Alex W: Escalation rules (short): page primary on-call -> if no ack in 3m, page secondary -> if still >10m or customer-impact escalates to Sev1, page oncall-lead (Sanjay K) and notify product + CSM. Pager sequence below.

Alex W: Paste of the quick escalation snippet:
```
# escalation pseudo
if customer_impact == true and errors > 10%:
  page(oncall_primary)
  wait(3m)
  if no_ack: page(oncall_secondary)
  wait(7m)
  if unresolved and severity_escalates: page(oncall_lead)  # Sanjay K
```

Sanjay K: +1. If you page me directly for urgent ops, include a short bullet: impact, steps tried, rollback option. I'll join the bridge if >= 3 customers affected or revenue-impacting. Night handoff note: between 02:00-06:00 UTC the oncall-lead is the fallback but try primary/secondary first.

Mira P: Noted. On runbooks: the embeddings-service runbook link is https://runbooks/internal/embeddings-service — the section 'fallbacks' lists `fallback-model-v1` and `kv-cache-clear` steps. I've done fallback-model switch and asked infra to hold off on cache clears until after the current spike.

ops-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice — regional GPU pool scaling planned at 20:00 UTC (1712352000). This may reduce transient capacity by ~15% for 10-20m. Auto-scaling policy should compensate, keep an eye on queued requests.

Alex W: Action items before I hand off in 15m:
- Mira will own the page route and acknowledgements
- I will update INC-2147 with current mitigation & customer list
- If errors rise above 15% or more than 5 tenants affected -> escalate to Sanjay immediately

Mira P: I'll update the runbook notes with the mitigation we did and watch for regression. If I need to escalate, I'll include a screenshot of the error surge and the roll-back toggle state.

Lena R: One more ask: add the contact numbers for oncall-lead and oncall-secondary to the runbook header (makes pager calls faster).

Alex W: Good call, will add. Handoff: I'm marking myself as off for 22:00 UTC and leaving the bridge link in the ticket. Mira, any last Qs?

Mira P: None. Taking over primary now. I'll ping here if the situation changes. :thumbsup:
